criteria.criterion: Investigate cross-thread communication and playback ownership in actual ChatGPT MCP Apps instances, documenting platform and scope limits.
criteria.evidence: Inspector connected successfully. tools-list.json exposes open_capability_probe with resource ui://dial/capability-probe-v2.html. app-info.json reports an MCP App, connectDomains [], and resourceDomains [https://stream.radioparadise.com]; resource-read.json contains the delivered HTML. No actual ChatGPT two-thread logs or platform-scope observations were provided, so host behavior remains unverified.
criteria.method: Connect MCP Inspector CLI to the refreshed local MCP endpoint; list tools, inspect open_capability_probe app metadata, and read the delivered v2 UI resource. Actual two-thread ChatGPT interaction is an owner-only host procedure.

criteria.criterion: Within the supported scope, starting playback in one Dial instance stops or pauses any previously playing Dial instance so two streams do not remain audible together.
criteria.evidence: The tool-call response explicitly instructs opening the probe in two ChatGPT threads and collecting both frames' results. This candidate is the diagnostic capability probe; the full single-playback coordination feature has not been implemented. No audible observation or two-frame transfer logs exist.
criteria.method: Inspect the accepted probe delivery and implementation scope, then check for the required real two-frame transfer and audible observations.

criteria.criterion: Play and Pause behavior in a second thread is defined explicitly, including whether its controls operate the active playback or transfer ownership.
criteria.evidence: The resource provides diagnostic transfer and pause/release controls and asks users to confirm audible sound, but no ChatGPT host logs establish second-thread control behavior. This probe does not implement the full feature semantics.
criteria.method: Inspect the delivered probe instructions and require actual ChatGPT two-frame Play/Pause observations for behavioral verification.

criteria.criterion: Playback ownership and visible player state recover predictably after rapid interactions, closed or remounted instances, and unavailable coordination.
criteria.evidence: The Implement report records passing queued-transfer cancellation and self-contention regression repros and 23 passing automated tests; Review accepted attempt 2. These are local tests. No real ChatGPT background delivery, frame close/remount, or visible-state recovery observations were captured.
criteria.method: Check the accepted candidate's bounded cancellation/self-contention regression evidence and require real host background, close/remount, and recovery observations.

criteria.criterion: Automated coordination tests and separate actual two-thread ChatGPT playback evidence cover the approved behavior.
criteria.evidence: The Implement report records npm test PASS (23 tests) and the reviewer repro tests PASS; the new Inspector artifacts tools-list.json, app-info.json, tool-call.json, and resource-read.json verify local MCP tool/resource delivery. The required separate actual two-thread ChatGPT playback and audible evidence is absent. Local tests and Inspector output are not a substitute.
criteria.method: Use recorded accepted-candidate automated test results and independently perform the MCP Inspector protocol/resource smoke check; verify whether separate two-thread ChatGPT playback evidence exists.
